title: Analytic: on-axis dipole radiation, flux faces and far field (body of revolution, FDFD)
description:
A z-directed current element I on the rotation axis (em_fdfd_bor, azimuthal order m = 0; the axis cell carries a current disc of moment p = I dx_cell) in vacuum, cpml on r_hi and both z faces, stationary solve at lambda0 = 1 um on the (r, z) half plane (25 nm cells, ~4.3e4 unknowns, host SuperLU).
Analytic: the time-averaged Poynting vector of a point dipole is exactly radial at every distance, S = U_max sin^2(theta) / R^2 with U_max = eta0 k^2 p^2 / (32 pi^2), so the power through a surface is the solid-angle integral of U: total P = eta0 k^2 p^2 / (12 pi); through the top disc of a box of half height h and radius R (cos theta_1 = h / sqrt(h^2 + R^2) = c) P_top = 2 pi U_max (2/3 - c + c^3/3), through its side cylinder P_side = 2 pi U_max 2 (c - c^3/3), through the bottom disc -P_top (flux_monitor is positive toward +z / +r).
Derived values tab: P_top, P_bottom, P_side (flux monitors on the box faces, 2 pi ring weights, exactly conserved discrete flux) vs their references (P_top - P_bottom + P_side = P_total = eta0 k^2 p^2 / (12 pi)); U_equator / U_equator_back (far_field power per steradian at angle 0 / pi, the equator on both sides of the axis) vs U_max.
Far field tab: em.far vs the dashed sin^2(theta) = cos^2(angle) pattern (angle from +r toward +z in the drawing plane; peak-normalised).
Field tab: |E_z| and |E|^2 of the solve.
Expected agreement: ~1-3 % (the discrete current disc and numerical dispersion at 40 cells per wavelength, the PML reflection); to be confirmed by a first run.

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (40 cells per wavelength)

parameters.name: L_r
parameters.description: radial extent of the half plane (cpml beyond)

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: source r: the axis cell centre

parameters.name: h_face
parameters.description: distance of the top / bottom flux faces from the source

parameters.name: R_face
parameters.description: radius of the side flux face (a cell edge)

parameters.name: c_top
parameters.description: cos of the polar angle of the box corner
